# BTTSPredict

> BTTSPredict publie quotidiennement des pronostics BTTS (Both Teams To Score) et Over 2.5 sur le football, générés par un moteur IA nouvelle génération basé sur la forme récente des équipes. Les données proviennent de sources publiques (ESPN et TheSportsDB). Tous les pronostics sont archivés quotidiennement et vérifiés après le résultat officiel. Le suivi public a été lancé le 8 août 2026. Aucun résultat futur n'est garanti.

## What BTTSPredict offers

- Daily BTTS and Over 2.5 football predictions on a curated set of leagues with historically high BTTS rates
- Public verified history — wins and losses displayed transparently, no retroactive modification
- Transparent methodology: AI engine based on recent team form, calibrated continuously
- Two-tier VIP access (Essentiel + Pro) with WhatsApp activation
- Affiliate partnership with Linebet (code VISION221) and 888starz
- 18+ responsible gambling compliance, begambleaware.org linked

## Coverage

- Markets: BTTS (Both Teams To Score) and Over 2.5 goals
- Leagues: selected European and North-American leagues with historically high BTTS rates
- Sources: ESPN Soccer API (public, no key) + TheSportsDB (public, no key)
- Verification: post-match final scores retrieved from ESPN + TheSportsDB

## Methodology summary

BTTSPredict uses a probabilistic engine that estimates the likelihood of BTTS and Over 2.5 outcomes from each team's recent offensive and defensive form. The engine is calibrated continuously and applies quality filters before publishing any prediction. Internal parameters (variables, thresholds, league list, constants) are not publicly disclosed. See /methodologie for the public overview.

## Public verified history

A new public tracking period was launched on 8 August 2026. Every prediction published since that date is:
- Recorded in a daily timestamped archive
- Verified after the official match result via ESPN and TheSportsDB
- Counted in public statistics (win rate, 14-day trend)
- Immutable — a published prediction is never modified retroactively

Predictions published before 8 August 2026 are kept in a private archive for internal technical audit and are not displayed publicly.
